job.title: Dog Waste Cleanup Pro (Independent Contractor)
job.description:
ByeByeDoody is a referral marketplace that connects households with independent dog-waste cleanup pros. We are now accepting independent providers in the New York, NY area, including Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, Long Island, Westchester.

What you do

  • Pick up and bag dog waste from residential yards, one-time or on a weekly route.
  • Choose the jobs you want in your own ZIP codes and send your own price quote.
  • Close gates, keep pets safe and dispose of waste lawfully.

How it works

  • Independent contractor role, not employment. You set your own prices and hours.
  • Get instant email alerts for new requests in your ZIP codes. Quote in seconds with an AI price suggestion.
  • You keep your full quoted rate. Customers pay a 15% platform fee on top.
  • Pay is per job and set by you. Our price guide suggests about $15–$45 per weekly visit and $35–$95 per one-time cleanup, depending on dogs and yard size.
  • Payouts go through Stripe straight to your bank.

What you need

  • Your own small cleanup business (a sole proprietorship is fine) and any local registration that applies.
  • Your own tools, supplies and transportation.
  • A smartphone with email, and a bank account for Stripe payouts.

Applying is free. Joining does not make you an employee, and the number of jobs or income is not guaranteed; it depends on customer demand in your ZIP codes and your quotes.
